long_biography.plain_text:
Buying his first multipurpose carrier gave Harren a platform for combining ownership with technical and commercial ship management. He built the Bremen company around a deliberately varied fleet, spreading its work across container feeders, bulkers, tankers, heavy-lift carriers and dock ships.

Partnerships and acquisitions extended that platform into more complex transport work. Caribbean feeder services and Combi Lift added regional shipping and project logistics, while the acquisition of SAL Heavy Lift deepened specialist heavy-lift capability. Harren also pursued a long-running partnership to establish ship-repair capacity in Jamaica. His son Martin now serves as Group CEO, succeeding Peter in day-to-day leadership of the family-run business.
